extracted.intended_audience: parties, attorneys, and other filers/participants in proceedings before the Florida Division of Administrative Hearings (DOAH); registered eALJ users
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and mandatory practices for filing documents, receiving orders, using eALJ electronic service, redacting confidential information, and requesting disability accommodations for proceedings before the Florida Division of Administrative Hearings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic transmission of orders to registered eALJ users
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective immediately ALL orders issued by the Division will be transmitted to registered eALJ users in electronic format only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registered eALJ users will receive orders only electronically; non-registered parties will continue to receive orders in paper format. This is presented as an effective/mandatory change in DOAH practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered users must ensure e-mail address is correct in eALJ
rubrics_metrics.description: It is incumbent upon registered users to ensure their e-mail address is correct in eALJ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because orders and eService will be transmitted electronically to the address on file, users bear responsibility for maintaining accurate contact information to receive official communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: eService of pleadings to parties registered with eALJ
rubrics_metrics.description: The Division now provides eService of pleadings to parties registered with eALJ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: eFilers may avail themselves of eService through the eALJ portal, or may do so through some other means. This indicates eService is available but may be effected via the portal or alternative methods permitted by DOAH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsibility to redact or remove confidential/private information
rubrics_metrics.description: Every person filing a document at DOAH has the responsibility to ensure that no information protected by privacy or confidentiality laws is contained in any document that would be posted to DOAH's website in the regular course of business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filers must redact (black out) or remove any protected private or confidential information, including but not limited to a social security number, from every document filed at DOAH. This is a filer-level duty to prevent posting of protected information to the public website.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice to persons with disabilities: accommodation entitlement and request methods
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are a person with a disability who requires an accommodation in order to participate in a Division of Administrative Hearings proceeding or event, you are entitled, at no cost to you, to the provision of certain assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests for accommodations may be presented on the ADA Title II Request Form, in another written format, or orally. Submit the completed form to the ADA Coordinator by fax (850) 921-6847; by mail at 2001 Drayton Drive, Tallahassee, FL 32311; or by email to ADA@doah.state.fl.us. Requests should be submitted as far in advance as possible, but preferably at least seven (7) days before your scheduled appearance.
